headline: Fishermen's Row Erupts Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition, Fishermen's Row has roared back to life after its brief lull: six base events in the past two hours, the latest at our filing, and its nine works narrowed to five Warden against four Colonial. The Deadlands logged no flips in the same span, its newest event a little over two hours old, yet the day's toll there passes 32,000 and its eleven works now read six Colonial to five Warden, the hourly pace easing from noon's fury. Kings Cage has seen no events since yesterday evening while its day's losses top 13,000, and the Weathered Expanse's exchange nears 34,000 without a change of flags. Fresh alarm comes from Clahstra, where casualties accelerate sharply though every work still flies Colonial colours. Lykos Isle has cooled, its last event four hours old with works split four Warden to three, while Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf both recorded captures within the day and remain divided. The remaining fronts stand quiet. This is the seventy-first day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
